author: Astrokillah
text:
ADUCAD Failed Trade Analysis

I believe we need to be absolutely honest with ourselves. Analyzing
failed trade is painful, especially when it challenges our fundamental
belief/faith.

In my opinion, this AUDCAD is one that is challenging to rationalized, I
 would go through it step by step and welcome any critics/feedback.

This is the basic setup:

As far as I can see, the ONLY thing that 'negated' this short setup is
price bouncing from point 3 (SR swapped level). Master IF has made it
absolutely clear that a valid engulf PA is one that engulf an FL and not
 yet reached next target (i.e. engulf into free space). However, I am
sure you would agree with me if you watch enough chart, yes, we can
often find engulf of FL, the problem is very few are engulf into free
space. 99% of the time, after price has engulfed an FL, it hit some kind
 of FL/SD/DP/SR and bounced from there back towards our entry.

Let's look at Area A in more details:

And we look at how price reacting to these levels. It blasted through
the entry level (LS/SR) easily, paused a bit under the blue FL, and
eventually broke above it.

In chart below, we look at LTF price action inside the red circle, this
is to examine if there is any LTF PA for short (should we decide not to
touch trade):

As you can see, price did engulf a LTF FL, into free space. If we had to
 trade this the RTM way, we should put our stop loss above the blue FL.
However, price went on to break the blue FL and stop us out.

That begs a question: Is this just one of the few instances where Institutional Traders decided NOT to honor the engulf PA?

cheers

AK

author: Astrokillah
text:
OMG bestgmx! You have just brought an EXCELLENT POINT - BROKER DATA!!!

Man oh man, why I keep forgetting about this? How can we trust only one
broker data?! As you know I'm with IC Markets, and on AUDCAD, there was a
 clear ENGULF PA on 1-min chart. However, when I check my other broker -
 Dukascopy, there was NO ENGULF!!!!!!

The moral of the story ==> Do not trust data from just one broker,
especially when our margin of error is so thin (RTM considers 1 pip
overshot as ENGULF!), so always check the engulf using several broker
data.

USDJPY - Is this an ENGULF or Target reached?

This is really puzzling me, see chart below:

We have a CPAZ, which was engulfed at Point 2. However, the RBD (peak)
at Point 2 also hit the DBR (valley) at point 1, so do we consider this
as target reached, and therefore there is no PA for long?

The alternative view is, should we consider the engulf of CPAZ a valid
PA for long, then our target will be the DP just above the CPAZ.

cheers

Astro
